title: 14mm NippleSnake For DynaVap Tips
description:
NippleSnake Stem For Dynavap
Twist up your Dynavap session with this glass NippleSnake stem which features a small airport, 14mm connection and indents that are pushed into the glass right through the spiral section. The indents contribute to the cooling affect the NippleSnake has. It offers a simple yet smooth experience when paired with a dynavap tip and your favourite 14mm bubbler.
The small airport on the NippleSnake is a good size that will alleviates some draw restriction when using with your bubbler and of course can be covered or partially covered while in use.
Dynavap Tip & Cap NOT INCLUDED.
Included
1 x 14mm NippleSnake
